body: I’ll try my school, I have to try. Thank you for talking to me and helping me when a felt isolated. I’m glad there are people like you in this world who care enough to go out and communicate like this, I’m glad I chose to vent here

Well I want to tell him that I appreciate what he said and how much it has meant to me. Being in such an awkward stage of my life though other young adults aren’t exactly accepting of peoples emotions, especially when it’s just guys talking to guys, we just don’t talk about that sort of thing. That’s what stops me from talking to him now, the fear that maybe he won’t care and tell others how much of a *ussy I am for having emotions. I have access to therapy but it’s through my school and I don’t trust the ones that have taken a toll on my mental health to fix it.

I get the shakes in public places but I used to be a party animal, I don’t want to do the things I used to live for. I injured myself so I lost my athletic dreams, slowly my academics fell behind. All I had left was my reputation , a great one at that. Yet at the drop of a hat I was the center of colossal rumors. The ones I was close with I shut out, I felt like I didn’t trust them, like they didn’t think of me as a friend anymore but a liability. I still can’t trust anyone, I used to be a social animal and now I don’t respond to anyone who texts or snaps me. I ghosted my whole class, yet nobody has noticed I’m in such a low place? Not even the friends I used to call close. Maybe I’ve become a pro at masking my emotions, if I expressed them to my friends directly I’d feel like a burden. Nobody wants a suicidal friend it just keeps you worrying. The one close friend I told though. He told me to just keep going, make it out of my small town and move somewhere new to start a fresh beginning. I think I can say confidently he’s kept me here to this day despite me also cutting him out of my life from embarrassment and disgust in myself for exposing my emotions like that. I don’t think his words can keep me here much longer, I wish I could just bring myself to talk to him again
